name: portfolio-sergio-meyer
description: Ferramentas de desenvolvimento para o portfólio de Sérgio Meyer.

scripts.build: esbuild src/script.ts src/engineering.ts src/terminal.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --outdir=. --banner:js="/* Gerado a partir de src/*.ts por npm run build. Edite os arquivos em src/. */"
scripts.verify:build: npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- script.js engineering.js terminal.js
scripts.lint: npm run lint:html && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
